state:
Teledoc: a self-hosted Telegram channel document archive. A bot watches a Telegram channel; every document posted there is archived into a local database with auto-tagging, browsable via a web UI. New feature: the bot reacts to the document message in the channel itself so the channel becomes a status indicator:
- ARCHIVED: the document was archived successfully (normal case, most messages).
- TAG_FAILURE: archiving succeeded but the tagging step failed (needs attention, rare).
- DUPLICATE: a file with the same filename was already archived before from this channel (a reupload).

Hard constraint: Telegram bots may only react with a fixed whitelist of emoji. The requested emoji (check mark, warning sign, repeat) are NOT whitelisted, so we must pick the closest equivalents from this allowed list: ❤ 👍 👎 🔥 🧰 👏 😁 🤔 🤯 😱 🤬 😢 🎉 🤩 🤮 💩 🙏 👌 🕊 🤡 🥱 🥴 😍 🐳 ❤‍🔥 🌚 🌭 💯 🤣 ⚡ 🍌 🏆 💔 🤨 😐 🍓 🍾 💋 🖕 😈 😴 😭 🤓 👻 👩‍💻 👀 🎃 🙈 😇 😨 🤝 ✍ 🤗 🫡 🎅 🎄 ☃ 💅 🤪 🗿 🆒 💘 🙉 🦄 😘 💊 🙊 😎 👾 🤷‍♂ 🤷 🤷‍♀ 😡

The reaction should be instantly understandable next to a document in a channel, calm (not alarming) for the routine case, and distinct from the other two reactions so the three states are telling apart at a glance.

emoji_archived.instructions: Which emoji should the bot react with when a document was ARCHIVED successfully (routine, most common event)? Pick the single best option.

criteria.\ud83d\udc4d: Universal calm 'done' signal; reads as 'ok, saved' without drama
criteria.\ud83d\udc4c: Slightly playful 'all good'; less conventional for archives
criteria.\u26a1: Conveys fast processing; energetic but less clearly 'success'
criteria.\ud83c\udf89: Celebratory; reads as a special event rather than routine confirmation

emoji_tag_failure.instructions: Which emoji should the bot react with when archiving succeeded but TAGGING FAILED (rare, needs human attention, but not a disaster)? Pick the single best option.

criteria.\ud83e\udd14: Soft 'something needs attention'; readable as a warning without panic
criteria.\ud83d\udc40: Reads as 'look at this' rather than 'error'
criteria.\ud83d\udc94: Strongly negative, reads as broken/failed but emotionally exaggerated
criteria.\ud83d\ude48: Playful 'I looked away / something went wrong'; meme-ish
criteria.\ud83d\ude31: Alarming; reads as disaster rather than a routine tagging hiccup

emoji_duplicate.instructions: Which emoji should the bot react with when a DUPLICATE filename was reuploaded (the file was already archived before)? Pick the single best option.

criteria.\ud83d\udc40: Reads as 'already seen this before'; calm and informative
